text: Good afternoon, may mga naipon kami sa bahay pagkatapos ng ilang linggo, including plastic water bottles, aluminum soft drink cans, at lumang diyaryo na nakalagay sa isang malaking sako. Gusto sana naming ibenta lahat.

We recently cleaned our small grocery store and found several flattened cardboard delivery boxes, old newspapers, used paper bags, and plastic packaging from the products we sold. Can we bring all these materials to your junkshop for weighing and pricing?

May mga bote ng suka at garapong salamin kami galing sa kusina, kasama ang mga plastik na lalagyan ng pagkain at ilang lata ng aluminum soft drinks. Hindi pa namin naihihiwalay lahat dahil gusto muna naming malaman kung alin ang puwedeng ibenta sa inyo.

I found several old steel pipes, copper wires, and rusty iron brackets inside our storage room while repairing the house. There are also broken phone chargers, damaged computer cables, and plastic covers from some electronic devices. Do you accept these different materials?

After our family gathering, marami kaming natirang recyclable materials, such as aluminum food trays, empty glass juice bottles, cardboard boxes from food deliveries, and old paper plates' packaging. May ilang lumang magazine at papel din na gusto naming isama sa pagbebenta.

May nililinis kaming lumang computer shop at marami kaming nakitang sirang keyboard, computer mouse, power adapters, at mga electronic cable. Bukod doon, may plastic chairs, plastic storage containers, at bakal na piyesa mula sa mga lumang computer tables. Puwede ba itong dalhin nang sabay-sabay?

Our office is moving to another building, so we need to dispose of some recyclable materials we have accumulated over the years. We have stacks of printed paper, old notebooks, cardboard folders and boxes, glass containers from the pantry, and plastic water bottles from our employees.

May mga lumang aluminum window frames at crushed beverage cans kami mula sa renovation, pati na rin ang bakal na rods, steel brackets, at ilang tansong wire na natira pagkatapos ng pagkukumpuni. Nasa tabi rin ang mga kahon ng karton na pinaglagyan ng bagong construction materials.

I was sorting through our family's old belongings and found shampoo bottles, plastic detergent containers, old magazines, used printer paper, broken earphones, and a damaged router. There are also several empty glass perfume bottles and sauce jars that we kept in a separate box.

May halo-halong recyclables kami sa bodega na gusto naming ibenta this week. Kasama rito ang plastic pails at water bottles, lumang diyaryo at notebooks, mga kahon ng karton, aluminum cans, bakal na pipes, copper wires, glass jars, at sirang cellphone chargers. Hindi pa namin alam kung magkano ang kabuuang presyo kaya gusto naming ipa-check muna lahat.

Hello, we finally cleaned out our garage over the weekend and collected quite a lot of things that we think might be recyclable. There are some plastic buckets and containers, a pile of newspapers and paper bags, several cardboard shipping boxes, empty glass bottles, aluminum cans, and a few old metal parts from a broken shelf.

Boss, galing po ito sa maliit naming sari-sari store na pinaayos last week. May mga plastic bottles at wrappers, karton ng mga delivery, lumang papel at resibo, aluminum cans, at bakal na shelves na hindi na ginagamit. May nakita rin kaming sirang extension cord at lumang charger sa stockroom. Ano po kaya ang puwede ninyong bilhin sa mga ito?

During our school laboratory cleanup, we separated old worksheets, used notebooks, cardboard boxes, and paper packaging from the cabinets. We also found rusty steel brackets, some copper wires, damaged computer keyboards, and several old power adapters that have not worked for a long time.

May mga bote ng soft drinks na salamin, aluminum cans, plastic cups, at mga lalagyan ng mineral water na naiwan pagkatapos ng community event. Sa likod ng covered area, may nakita rin kaming bakal na frame at ilang metal rods na ginamit sa decoration. Gusto sana naming malaman kung tumatanggap kayo ng ganitong karaming halo-halong gamit.

We are clearing the stockroom of our online selling business because we need space for new inventory. We have cardboard shipping cartons, plastic bubble packaging and wrappers, old paper labels and invoices, aluminum cans from the pantry, and a box of damaged charging cables and adapters. Some items are still mixed together because we have not finished sorting.

Kuya, may sako-sako po kaming lumang gamit na naipon sa bahay ng lola ko. May mga bote na plastik, garapong salamin, dyaryo, papel, kahon ng karton, lata ng soft drinks, at ilang piraso ng bakal. May lumang charger at sirang earphones din po akong nakita sa drawer. Puwede po bang lahat na lang ang dalhin namin sa junkshop ninyo?

Our maintenance team replaced some damaged fixtures in the workshop and put the discarded materials in one corner. The pile contains steel pipes, iron rods, copper wiring, old aluminum frames, empty glass jars, and cardboard boxes that were used to transport replacement parts. We want to separate everything according to material before selling it.

Kahapon naglinis kami ng bahay dahil matagal nang hindi nagagamit ang storage area sa likod. Nakakita kami ng plastic basins, lumang shampoo bottles, mga kahon ng sapatos, lumang notebooks, at mga diyaryo. May mga aluminum trays at lata rin galing sa handaan, kasama ang mga bote ng salamin at sirang computer mouse. Sa garahe naman ay may bakal na kadena at tansong wire mula sa dati naming pagkukumpuni.

I'm not completely sure which of these items your junkshop accepts, but I would like to ask about a collection from our old warehouse. We have plastic containers, cardboard cartons, paper documents, aluminum scraps, steel pieces, glass bottles, and several damaged electronic accessories such as chargers and cables. Some materials are dirty or slightly damaged, so please identify the different categories before we arrange a pickup.

Good morning po, may mga recyclable materials kami mula sa bahay at maliit naming tindahan na gusto naming ibenta. May plastic pails, bottles, at food containers; lumang papel, notebooks, at diyaryo; mga kahon ng karton; aluminum cans at trays; bakal na pipes at copper wire; mga garapong salamin; at sirang cellphone chargers, computer cables, at keyboard. Nasa magkakahiwalay na sako at kahon ang iba pero may ilang halo-halo pa. Sana matulungan ninyo kaming matukoy ang bawat materyal at malaman kung alin ang may buying price.
